cursor.title: Cursor / VS Code (.cursor/mcp.json)
setup: 1. Create .cursor/mcp.json in your project
2. Copy the mcpServers section using the config-mcp format
3. Replace YOUR_MCP_API_KEY_HERE with your API key

config_mcp.title: Standard MCP Config (mcp.json)
setup: 1. Create a mcp.json file in your tools directory
2. Use the standardized mcpServers definition
3. Ensure the JMPY_API_KEY environment variable is set

n8n.title: n8n Automation
setup: 1. Add an MCP Node to your workflow
2. Set URL to https://jmpy.me/mcp
3. Add header x-mcp-key with your API key
4. Use SSE transport for high-throughput tasks

openai.title: ChatGPT Custom GPTs
openai.description: Integrate JMPY with ChatGPT using the OpenAPI specification.
setup: 1. Go to ChatGPT -> Explore -> Create a GPT
2. Click 'Configure' and scroll down to 'Actions'
3. Click 'Create new action'
4. Import from URL: https://jmpy.me/mcp/openapi.json
5. Set Authentication to 'API Key' (Auth Type: Custom, Custom Header Name: x-mcp-key)

gemini.title: Google Gemini Extensions
gemini.description: Connect JMPY to Gemini using the OpenAPI specification.
setup: 1. Create a Gemini Extension in Google AI Studio or Vertex AI
2. Import the OpenAPI spec from: https://jmpy.me/mcp/openapi.json
3. Configure authentication using the 'x-mcp-key' header and your JMPY API key

zapier.title: Zapier Central
zapier.description: Use JMPY tools within Zapier Central via OpenAPI.
setup: 1. Go to Zapier Central -> Behaviors -> Create Behavior
2. Import the OpenAPI spec URL: https://jmpy.me/mcp/openapi.json
3. Set authentication to Custom Header using 'x-mcp-key' and your API key
